title: Descent of the underlying finite etale stalk model
statement: Let S be a Noetherian quasi-separated scheme and c:C\to S a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism locally of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let s\in S and let Q be a finite etale cover of C_s^{loc}=C\times_S Spec O_{S,s} [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-pc-fibre-product]. There exist an open neighbourhood W of s, a finite etale cover R of C_W=c^{-1}(W), and a map l:C_s^{loc}\to C_W such that l followed by the open inclusion equals the canonical projection C_s^{loc}\to C, and l^*R is isomorphic to Q. No cover on another open and no comparison on an overlap are part of this conclusion.

proof.text: Express Spec O(S,s) as the inverse limit of affine open neighbourhoods of s. Base change by c. The stages C_W are qcqs because c is qcqs and W is affine. Inclusions between affine neighbourhoods are affine, so their base changes are affine. The resulting limit is the local family C_s^loc.

The finite etale cover Q is quasi-compact, separated and locally of finite presentation. Descend the underlying scheme and its structure map to a finitely presented morphism over one stage C_W. Descend finiteness and etaleness to later stages and pass to a common refinement; both properties persist under base change.

Package the finite etale morphism at that stage as R. The limit projection to C_W is l; its composite with the open inclusion is the projection to C by the cone equations. The cartesian comparison from descent is an isomorphism l^*R with Q in the finite etale category.

theorem FiniteEtale.exists_stalk_neighbourhood_model {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation c]
    (s : S) (Q : (Limits.pullback c (S.fromSpecStalk s)).FiniteEtale) :
    ∃ (W : S.Opens), s ∈ W ∧
      ∃ (R : (c ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
        (l : Limits.pullback c (S.fromSpecStalk s) ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme),
        l ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι = pullback.fst c (S.fromSpecStalk s) ∧
          Nonempty ((FiniteEtale.pullback l).obj R ≅ Q)
